said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.

posts.text: I visited Hexagon Agility’s manufacturing facility in Lincoln to see the innovative technology being produced right here in Nebraska. Their composite natural gas cylinders and fuel systems power trucks and buses around the world, reducing emissions and lowering operating costs. https://t.co/771anc9Gi8

Avera St. Anthony’s Hospital is a critical resource in Holt County. When they suffered this tragedy in 2024, the community united and did whatever they could to help. Through my role on the Senate Appropriations Committee, I was able to direct $3.5 million in federal funds to help the hospital rebuild. I am so pleased to see them back to providing quality care for their patients, and I thank everyone who played a role in getting this done. https://t.co/cgB2vKHJzO

My staff will be hosting local office hours tomorrow, November 17th, for Nebraskans in Seward County. If you need assistance with a federal agency, please stop by to see how my office can help! https://t.co/B0RAv9UO9y https://t.co/pX82LM5j8u

Unpredictable weather, high input costs, and low yields have made it increasingly difficult to make a living in agriculture. 

Our producers need stability and certainty. 

That is why I fought to secure permanent year-round E15 in the Senate version of this year’s Farm Bill.

Read more in my @theindependent piece: https://t.co/hrmOWma1kP
https://t.co/6i2xie5l6P

The ARS facility is going to make Nebraska a leader in precision ag research. I have worked hard over the years directing over $70 million in federal investments to this project which will build the future of American agriculture.
https://t.co/KLHvM9PqYF

Nebraska’s rural roads and bridges play an essential role in everyday life, from transporting ag products to market to safely sending kids to school. That’s why I secured $897,000 in federal funds to rehabilitate 8 bridges in Brown County.

Read more in my Ainsworth Star-Herald

My staff will be hosting local office hours tomorrow, November 12th, for Nebraskans in Jefferson County. If you need assistance with a federal agency, please stop by to see how my office can help! https://t.co/B0RAv9VlZ6 https://t.co/nlbbpcAcKG

Today, our nation pauses to honor the great Americans who have answered the call to serve in the U.S. military, and to recognize their patriotism, service, and sacrifice on behalf of our county.

We are blessed to live in the land of the free because of these brave men and women. https://t.co/dCNW8KJH1a

Proud to introduce fellow Nebraskan and friend, Greg Ibach, at today’s @SenateAgGOP hearing. Greg will bring years of experience and expertise to the role of Under Secretary of Agriculture for Trade and Foreign Agricultural Affairs. I look forward to seeing him confirmed by the Senate.
Wishing a happy birthday to @USMC! For 251 years, these heroes have answered the call to defend our nation in the air, on land, and at sea. https://t.co/kFXzxxD85E

Farmers and ranchers impacted by the Morrill, Cottonwood, Road 203, Anderson Bridge, Ashby, and Minor fires: USDA has extended the ECP application deadline until December 23, 2026. Click below to learn more about the process for applying or reach out to your local FSA office for
https://t.co/RDqWnJ98sV

Proud to help secure over $23 million to improve roadway safety across Nebraska. These projects in Lincoln, Beatrice, and Omaha will make improvements to two essential roadways, reduce serious public safety risks, and improve post-crash care. Read more: https://t.co/mpnpkIOrNN
Thinking of Senator Chris Murphy and his family this morning, and I’m wishing him a full and speedy recovery.
https://t.co/5VfOfcNPvy

Good news for Nebraska’s ranchers. This partnership will bring our beef to consumers in South Korea, opening new markets and creating more opportunities for producers. Expanding access to global markets is a win for our ranchers and rural communities.
https://t.co/UXmD1ExIRT

When Nebraskans need help, our first responders don’t hesitate to answer the call. Today, we celebrate the law enforcement, firefighters, medical professionals, and emergency dispatchers who work so hard to protect us. https://t.co/OliO7ETzkV

.@GeneralDynamics’s facility expansion will offer greater capacity to produce critical military components and create hundreds of jobs in Lincoln. This investment strengthens our national defense and is a win for Nebraska’s economy. Exciting to break ground last week! https://t.co/SzgOCJp8DO

Every day, men and women in law enforcement step into danger to keep Nebraskans safe. I hosted a roundtable discussion with local, state, and federal law enforcement agencies to hear about the challenges they face and resources they need. https://t.co/QNwQRfLAot

Today, we pay tribute to servicemembers who are or have been deployed across the globe. We are grateful to our active-duty personnel and their families for their strength and sacrifice. https://t.co/f6Zz3NUk40

This is a good thing for Nebraska’s taxpayers. Waste and fraud cost our federal programs billions every year—money that should be going to those who need it. I thank @USAO_NE for signing Vice President @JDVance’s pledge to root out this abuse of taxpayer dollars. https://t.co/vYkcEdPO11

Great news: Pacific Engineering Inc. has officially opened its 3rd facility! Their new site in North Omaha will support PEI’s work on our nation’s next-generation nuclear-armed sea-launched cruise missile. Great to see a Nebraska company play a critical role in strengthening https://t.co/61B5n5Sjg2
Good to be in Fremont to visit with Mayor Sookram and city leadership. Fremont is growing quickly, and it was great to hear about the projects happening in Dodge County. https://t.co/Ibrag3RNqH

Midwest Housing Equity Group is working to expand affordable housing in Nebraska. I toured a townhome at The Row, a new affordable housing development in Fremont. We discussed the critical role of the CDFI Fund in making projects like this possible. https://t.co/oW61cyCYRV

Eric Hamilton has built an impressive legal career defined by integrity, sound judgment, and a steadfast commitment to the rule of law. He has served Nebraska with distinction, and I am confident he will continue that tradition of service on the federal bench. I was proud to recommend his nomination to President Trump and look forward to supporting him through the Senate confirmation process. https://t.co/HVcYV1oPuQ

Nebraska’s rail infrastructure supports our strong state economy and connects our world-class products to the rest of the country. I’m proud to have supported investments into these three projects that will modernize our rail system and provide much-needed safety improvements. Read more below: https://t.co/x9CLVw7Obd

I've long pushed to bring critical mineral production and processing back to the United States. I could not be prouder to see Nebraska leading the way in securing America’s energy dominance. I appreciate the administration’s focus on strengthening our domestic critical mineral supply chain, and I thank @SecretaryWright and Chairman @JJovanovicUSA for supporting NioCorp’s plant in Elk Creek.

https://t.co/3cFH9VUoVF

Appreciated visiting Central Community College’s Columbus campus to hear about their early college programming and student support services. Thank you for all you do for Nebraska’s students. https://t.co/nm7wQBwGP1

Enjoyed meeting with Nebraskans in the National Association of Insurance and Financial Advisors to hear about the great work financial professionals do across the state. https://t.co/ryCawFhJaf

Nebraska remains competitive when it stays connected. That’s why I worked to secure federal funding to help build a new terminal at the North Platte Regional Airport—a game changer for western Nebraska.

Read more in my @NPTelegraph op-ed: https://t.co/anFDaWmZVz
Wishing @USNavy a happy 251st birthday! Since the birth of our nation, the Navy has courageously protected our waters and defended the homeland. https://t.co/FaAkYKO1NT
Wishing a happy National Farmer’s Day to Nebraska’s producers who feed, fuel, and clothe our nation! https://t.co/h4kqFIJCTq

In Nebraska’s Panhandle, every runway, road, and waterway plays a role in keeping people connected and communities moving forward.

That’s why I’m focused on securing federal investments for local infrastructure like the Western Nebraska Regional Airport, Heartland Expressway, and Gering-Fort Laramie Canal.

Read more in @sbstarherald:
https://t.co/ZXAl8dFGGG
https://t.co/0qe7pa6OyW

Three years ago, Hamas carried out a ruthless, cold-blooded attack on Israel and its people. Today, we honor the memory of the victims and stand with all who continue to carry the pain of that tragic day.

I visited the Nebraska Information Analysis Center, where law enforcement and public safety officials work together to share critical information and identify potential threats. I appreciated hearing about their work and touring the facility, including the computer crime lab I helped secure federal funding for.
It’s National Manufacturing Day! Thank you to Nebraska’s manufacturers for their hard work, which drives innovation and moves our economy forward. https://t.co/tIAMMQCxdQ
https://t.co/PmI7APkMBx
Met with @NebraskaMed to discuss their recent efforts in advancing maternal care throughout the state. Nebraska appreciates your hard work. https://t.co/kWf9hUXCd3
I had the pleasure of meeting with the 2026 Nebraska State Teacher of the Year, Sarah Hardin. Thank you for your outstanding service to the students of Mullen! https://t.co/d9jvVMKkQ9

Always great to sit down with the Associated General Contractors of Nebraska Highway Chapter to discuss our state’s transportation needs. https://t.co/QoIxi8UWJz

Nebraska’s farmers and biofuel producers work together to fuel our nation. Good to meet with @GPREINC  to discuss the 45Z tax credit and the opportunities it presents for our state. https://t.co/p8GO9yZ05B

I look forward to working with him and finding new ways we can help producers in Nebraska.

Military members never serve alone—their families sacrifice alongside them. Today, we show our respect and gratitude to the loved ones of those who have made the ultimate sacrifice in service to our country. https://t.co/gf3XohE6uY

roll_calls.question: Motion to Invoke Cloture on the Motion to Proceed: H.R. 7008
roll_calls.result: Cloture on the Motion to Proceed Rejected (53-47, 3/5 majority required)
roll_calls.plain_language: This was a vote to end debate on taking up the Stop Insider Trading Act, which would bar members of Congress and their spouses and dependent children from buying stocks and would require public notice before a sale. A Yea would have moved the Senate toward taking up the bill. A Nay blocked ending debate.
